This installation step exceeded its time limit. Completed components are retained; retry when the network is stable.
The download connection timed out. Check access to the download service or try another network.
The download host could not be resolved. Check network and DNS access.
The secure connection could not be verified. Check system time and the network; certificate checks remain enabled.
The network connection failed or was interrupted. Check access to the download service.
The download service denied the request. Repeated retries may not help.
The download service is rate-limiting requests. Wait before retrying.
The required download or dependency address was not found. Keep these diagnostics for troubleshooting.
There is not enough space in the environment or temporary download directory. Free internal storage before retrying.
Another package operation holds the installation lock. Wait for it to finish; do not remove the lock file.
The package manager could not restore a consistent dependency state. Keep these diagnostics for troubleshooting.
A required package, Python module, or native library is unavailable. Keep these diagnostics; downloading the browser again may not fix it.
The selected component does not support this environment or architecture.
The Linux installation command could not start. Check that the selected environment and its execution permissions are available.
The installation directory or completion status could not be written. This installation was not marked complete.
The cause is not yet known. Keep the stage and diagnostic code below for troubleshooting.
